page.layout: One page of text: a running head with the page number at top left; a centred heading "MEDIVM."; a grammatical table of Greek verb forms in three columns, with row labels in a left column and sub-headings between the blocks; a catchword at bottom right.
page.notes: The table's Greek forms were read from a small, worn scan; the endings in the Plusquamperfectum, Perfectum third person and the Infinitum b forms are uncertain and should be checked against the original. The row labels in the left column are in italic and partly abbreviated as printed. The reference mark on the "Infinitum b." heading is a stylised letter that I read as b. The "Futu-" at the foot is a catchword for the next section.
